summary: SwiftUI iOS app with a generated Xcode project, shared scheme and XCTest target

team_id.description: Apple developer team id (leave empty for simulator builds)

notes:
macOS with Xcode 15+ required. The .xcodeproj (including a shared scheme)
is generated, so 'xcodebuild -scheme ...' works without opening Xcode first.
Simulator builds need no code signing; device builds need --set team_id=XXXXXXXXXX.
